catalogue_title: Astronomy: Galileo, after using the telescope on the bell-tower of St Mark's Square, Venice, demonstrates his findings to the Doge, 1609. Engraving by J. P. Le Bas after himself, 1739.
description: Galileo Galilei demonstrated the telescope to the Doge Leonardo Donà on the Campanile di San Marco on 21 August 1609
